title: External agent tooling intake and disposition
trigger: A new tool, framework, plugin, provider, protocol, database, skill suite, or architecture is proposed for AgentSwitchboard evaluation or adoption.

steps.action: Preserve the literal source claim and aliases without upgrading it to fact.
steps.output: catalog candidate with reported or unresolved evidence state

steps.action: Classify kind, category, mention class, and proposed disposition.
Search existing AgentSwitchboard adapters, prompts, skills, registries, validators, and docs before proposing new ownership.
Before adoption, verify official upstream identity plus pinned version/commit, supported OS, install scope, security/privacy behavior, network/telemetry behavior, expected files, and rollback path.
Determine permissions, subprocess/filesystem/network behavior, provider credentials, persistence, update path, and whether local/private claims are actually proven.
Choose existing-reference, evaluate, compatibility, supporting, comparison, watchlist, or open a separately scoped implementation sprint.
Run catalog validators and git diff --check for tracked catalog changes.

stopConditions: required official source cannot be verified
installation would exceed current sprint authority
another canonical repo surface already owns the integration
outputs: updated tracked registry when evidence changes
separate implementation sprint when adoption is approved
proofCeiling: Evidence intake, classification, overlap analysis, and verified upstream metadata when actually collected; no installation or runtime proof.
